description: Ingest a PDF, DOCX, or other binary file into the knowledge graph. Use this whenever the user drops, mentions, or references a file (not raw text) that should become knowledge — reads the file from local disk, uploads it, and starts extraction. For plain text, use gctrl_extract/gctrl_store instead.

compilationId.description: Optional: target knowledge graph compilation ID. Omit to fall back to your default knowledge base.

ontologyId.description: Optional ontology ID to guide entity type extraction

path.description: Absolute (or cwd-relative) path to the local file to ingest, e.g. a PDF or DOCX

name: gctrl_ingest_file
